question: Which two hypervisors does Cisco HyperFlex support? (Choose two.)
explanation: Cisco HyperFlex systems include a purpose-built, high-performance, low-latency hyperconverged platform that adapts to support any application, in any cloud, anywhere. The platform supports multiple hypervisors and virtualized environments (Microsoft Windows Server 2019 Hyper-V, VMware vSphere), Docker containers with Kubernetes, multicloud services, and edge deployments to efficiently and economically deploy, monitor, and manage applications.
